+                or not index_cache.is_contiguous()
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"index_cache must be contiguous {self.index_cache_dtype} "
+                    f"[physical rows >= {self.index_max_seq}, {index_width}], got "
+                    f"{tuple(index_cache.shape)} {index_cache.dtype}"
+                )
+            if self.kv_cache_layout is KvCacheLayout.ATOM:
+                block_tables = (
+                    self.identity_block_tables if block_tables is None else block_tables
+                )
+                expected_blocks = (
+                    self.S // self.index_request_width,
+                    self.index_block_table_stride,
+                )
+                if (
+                    block_tables is None
+                    or block_tables.ndim != 2
+                    or block_tables.shape[0] < expected_blocks[0]

+                ):

+                    )
+        if self.kv_cache_layout is KvCacheLayout.ATOM:
+            cache_width = GLM5_CONFIG.kv_lora + GLM5_CONFIG.pe_dim
+            fp8_dtypes = {
+                dtype
+                for dtype in (
+                    getattr(torch, "float8_e4m3fn", None),
+                    getattr(torch, "float8_e4m3fnuz", None),
+                )
+                if dtype is not None
+            }
+            expected_dtype = (
+                kv_cache.dtype in fp8_dtypes
+                if self.kv_cache_dtype == "fp8"
+                else kv_cache.dtype is torch.bfloat16
+            )
+            if not expected_dtype or not kv_cache.is_contiguous():
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"ATOM KV cache must be contiguous {self.kv_cache_dtype}"
+                )
+            if kv_cache.shape[-1] != cache_width:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"ATOM KV cache last dimension must be {cache_width}, got {tuple(kv_cache.shape)}"
+                )
+            if kv_cache.data_ptr() != pe_cache.data_ptr():
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "ATOM KV cache layout requires the same fused tensor for kv_cache and pe_cache"
+                )
+            for name, value, dtype, size in (
+                ("positions", positions, torch.int64, total_samples),
+                ("slot_mapping", slot_mapping, torch.int64, total_samples),
+                ("sparse_kv_indptr", sparse_kv_indptr, torch.int32, total_samples + 1),
+            ):
+                if (
+                    value is None
+                    or value.dtype is not dtype
+                    or value.numel() < size
+                    or not value.is_contiguous()
+                ):
+                    got = None if value is None else (tuple(value.shape), value.dtype)
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"{name} must be contiguous {dtype} with at least {size} values, got {got}"
+                    )
+        t = dict(self.W.t, **self.packed)
+        if x_out is None:
+            x_out = torch.empty(
+                total_samples, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=h.device
+            )
+        elif x_out.shape != (total_samples, HIDDEN):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"x_out must have shape {(total_samples, HIDDEN)}, got {tuple(x_out.shape)}"
+            )
+        p = lambda x: x.data_ptr()  # noqa: E731
+        for chunk in range(chunks):
+            row = chunk * self.S
+            self.launch(
+                p(h) + row * HIDDEN * h.element_size(),
+                p(x_out) + row * HIDDEN * x_out.element_size(),
+                p(block_tables)
+                if (self.with_indexer or self.shared_indices)
+                and self.kv_cache_layout is KvCacheLayout.ATOM
+                else p(cur_pos),
+                p(cur_pos if positions is None else positions)
+                + (0 if positions is None else row * 8),
+                p(cur_pos if slot_mapping is None else slot_mapping)
+                + (0 if slot_mapping is None else row * 8),
+                p(cur_pos if sparse_kv_indptr is None else sparse_kv_indptr)
+                + (0 if sparse_kv_indptr is None else row * 4),
+                p(kv_cache),
+                p(pe_cache),
+                p(index_cache) if self.with_indexer else p(indices),
+                p(cos),
+                p(sin),
+                p(t["g_in"]),
+                p(t["g_q"]),
+                p(t["g_kv"]),
+                p(t["g_post"]),
+                p(t["w_qkv_a"]),
+                p(t.get("s_qkv_a", t["w_qkv_a"])),
+                p(t["w_q_b"]),
+                p(t.get("s_q_b", t["w_q_b"])),
+                p(t["w_uk"]),
+                p(t.get("s_uk", t["w_uk"])),
+                p(t["w_uv"]),
+                p(t.get("s_uv", t["w_uv"])),
+                p(t["w_o"]),
+                p(t.get("s_o", t["w_o"])),
+                p(t["w_r"]),
+                p(t["bias"]),
+                p(t["w_ug"]),
+                p(t["s_ug"]),
+                p(t["w_dn"]),
+                p(t["s_dn"]),
+                p(self.scratch),
+                self.sym,
+                p(self.peers),
+                (p(self.index_params) if self.index_params is not None else 0),
+                p(self.step),
+                self.rank,
+                layer,
+                stream=torch.cuda.current_stream(),
+            )
+            if chunk + 1 < chunks or advance:
+                self.advance_step()

+
+    def advance_step(self):
+        self.step.add_(1)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Step-mode specialized decode: lifecycle, per-step plan and fail-stop.
+
+``plan()`` runs once per forward. A single-token decode step (eager, or inside
+a FULL graph capture) runs every MoE layer as one kernel launch (``run``);
+every other step runs vLLM's layers. Every predicate reads host state that
+every TP rank holds alike: the kernels all-reduce in-kernel, so ranks that
+disagreed would wait on each other until the fail-stop bound.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, cast
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+
+from .guards import cache_refusals, model_refusals
+from .spec import DecodeConfig
+
+FAULT_MESSAGE = (
+    "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode: a kernel wait timed out on some rank "
+    "(fail-stop word set); the step is discarded"
+)
+
+
+def tp_agree(ok: bool) -> bool:
+    from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.runtime.consensus import (  # noqa: E501
+        tp_agree as agree,
+    )
+
+    return agree(ok, get_tp_group().cpu_group)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Step:
+    """One planned step: ``rows`` tokens, ``q`` consecutive ones per request."""
+
+    rows: int
+
+
+def step_refusal(
+    context, layer_name: str, positions: torch.Tensor, widths, q: int = 1
+) -> str | None:
+    """Why this forward runs vLLM's layers, or None for the kernels: a decode
+    step of whole requests of ``q`` rows each (a speculative verify block, its
+    causality from each row's position; padded rows have slot -1)."""
+    rows = positions.shape[0]
+    if rows not in widths or rows % q:
+        return f"{rows} rows"
+    if positions.dtype != torch.int64:
+        return f"positions {positions.dtype}"
+    if context.ubatch_slices is not None:
+        return "microbatched"
+    metadata = context.attn_metadata
+    if not isinstance(metadata, dict) or not isinstance(context.slot_mapping, dict):
+        return "no per-layer metadata"
+    md = cast(Any, metadata.get(layer_name))
+    if md is None or md.num_prefills or md.max_query_len != q:
+        return "not a pure decode step"
+    if getattr(md, "num_decode_tokens", 0) > rows:
+        return "more decode tokens than rows"
+    bt = md.block_table
+    if bt.dtype != torch.int32 or bt.dim() != 2 or bt.stride(1) != 1:
+        return "block table layout"
+    slots = context.slot_mapping.get(layer_name)
+    if slots is None or slots.dtype != torch.int64:
+        return "slot mapping"
+    return None
+
+
+class SpecializedDecode:
+    """Built after weight loading; never replaces stock modules or parameters."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model, config: DecodeConfig, max_model_len: int) -> None:
+        self.model = model
+        self.config = config
+        reasons = model_refusals(model, config)
+        if not tp_agree(not reasons):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode model unsupported: "
+                + ("; ".join(reasons) or "refused on another TP rank")
+            )
+        from .runner import MonoRunner
+
+        self.runner = MonoRunner(model, config, max_model_len)
+        self.layer_name = self.runner.layer_name
+        self.index_name = self.runner.index_name
+        self._closed = False
+        self.mono_steps = 0
+        self.stock_steps = 0
+
+    @classmethod
+    def build(cls, model, config: DecodeConfig, vllm_config) -> SpecializedDecode:
+        return cls(model, config, vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len)
+
+    def _bind(self, context) -> None:
+        """The first planned step: check the caches, build the launchers."""
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode: first bind during graph capture"
+            )
+        reasons = cache_refusals(self.model, self.runner.max_model_len)
+        slots = context.slot_mapping
+        index_slots = slots.get(self.index_name)
+        if index_slots is None or not torch.equal(
+            index_slots[:1], slots[self.layer_name][:1]
+        ):
+            # the kernels insert K/V and the index key through one slot mapping
+            reasons.append("the index cache does not share the KV cache's block ids")
+        if not tp_agree(not reasons):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode caches unsupported: "
+                + ("; ".join(reasons) or "refused on another TP rank")
+            )
+        md = context.attn_metadata[self.layer_name]
+        page = self.model.layers[1].self_attn.attn.kv_cache.shape[1]
+        self.runner.bind(page, md.block_table.stride(0))
+
+    def plan(self, positions: torch.Tensor, intermediate_tensors) -> Step | None:
+        if (
+            intermediate_tensors is not None
+            or self._closed
+            or not is_forward_context_available()
+        ):
+            self.stock_steps += 1
+            return None
+        context = get_forward_context()
+        if step_refusal(
+            context, self.layer_name, positions, self.config.widths, self.config.q
+        ):
+            self.stock_steps += 1
+            return None
+        if not self.runner.bound:
+            self._bind(context)
+        stride = context.attn_metadata[self.layer_name].block_table.stride(0)
+        if stride != self.runner.block_table_stride:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"block table width {stride} != bound {self.runner.block_table_stride}"
+            )
+        self.mono_steps += 1
+        return Step(positions.shape[0])
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        step: Step,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.runner.forward(input_ids, positions, inputs_embeds)
+
+    def after_step(self) -> None:
+        """After every forward (kernels or stock, eager or in a FULL graph),
+        before logits: a device-side assert that the fail-stop word is clear. A
+        set word traps the GPU queue, so none of the step's later work runs and
+        the worker aborts: no token of a failed step reaches a client."""
+        if not self._closed:
+            torch._assert_async(self.runner.fault_word[0] == 0, FAULT_MESSAGE)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._closed:
+            return
+        self._closed = True
+        self.runner.close()

+from __future__ import annotations

+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from .spec import DecodeConfig

+LATENT = 576  # MLA latent row (bf16 or E4M3 values): kv_lora 512 + rope 64

+
+
+def model_refusals(model, config: DecodeConfig) -> list[str]:
+    """After load: the layer mix, each kernel layer's weights, the device."""
+    from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.runtime.consensus import (  # noqa: E501
+        MonoUnsupported,
+    )
+
+    from .weights import check_moe_layer, moe_kinds
+
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    layers = list(model.layers)
+    try:
+        moe_kinds(layers)
+    except MonoUnsupported as err:
+        reasons.append(str(err))
+    for layer in layers[1:]:
+        try:
+            check_moe_layer(layer)
+        except (MonoUnsupported, AttributeError) as err:
+            reasons.append(f"layer {layer.self_attn.spec.layer_idx}: {err}")
+    # aux hidden-state taps (DSpark) are cloned off the residual stream between
+    # launches by MonoRunner.forward
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        reasons.append("requires ROCm")
+        return reasons
+    try:
+        import flydsl  # noqa: F401
+        from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels import buffer_ops  # noqa: F401
+
+        from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+    except ImportError as err:
+        reasons.append(f"requires FlyDSL and AITER FlyDSL helpers ({err})")
+        return reasons
+    if get_cdna_version() != 4:
+        reasons.append("requires CDNA4 / gfx950")
+    index = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    cus = current_platform.get_device_properties(index).multi_processor_count
+    if cus != config.blocks:
+        reasons.append(f"requires {config.blocks} compute units, found {cus}")
+    return reasons
+
+
+def cache_refusals(model, max_model_len: int) -> list[str]:
+    """At bind: every kernel layer's latent and indexer caches."""
+    reasons: list[str] = []
+    page = None
+    for layer in list(model.layers)[1:]:
+        attn = layer.self_attn
+        i = attn.spec.layer_idx
+        kv = attn.attn.kv_cache
+        # bf16, or fp8 (E4M3) which vLLM stores as uint8 and views as fp8 per call
+        if (
+            kv.dim() != 3
+            or kv.dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.uint8, torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            or kv.shape[-1] != LATENT
+        ):

+            continue
+        if not kv.is_contiguous():
+            reasons.append(f"layer {i}: KV cache pages not contiguous {kv.stride()}")
+        page = kv.shape[1] if page is None else page
+        if kv.shape[1] != page or page % 16:
+            reasons.append(f"layer {i}: KV cache page {kv.shape[1]}")
+        icache = attn.indexer.k_cache.kv_cache if attn.indexer is not None else None

+            or tuple(icache.shape[1:]) != (page, INDEX_ROW)
+            or not icache.is_contiguous()
+        ):
+            reasons.append(
+                f"layer {i}: index cache {icache.dtype} {tuple(icache.shape)}"
+            )
+    return reasons

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Per-rank launch state of the Mistral Large 4 specialized decode.
+
+The embedding and the dense layer 0 run the original modules; every MoE layer
+(1..71) is one launch mapping the residual stream ``x`` ([rows, hidden]) to the
+next layer's ``x`` (attention, MoE and both TP all-reduces inside the kernel),
+alternating between two buffers; the final norm runs the original module. Each
+row is one request's single decode token. The kernels read and write vLLM's
+own caches: the bf16 MLA latent pages ([blocks, page, 576]) and the DSA
+indexer's FP8 key pages ([blocks, page, 132]), through the step's block table
+(one row per request) and slot mapping. A padded row (slot ``PAD_SLOT_ID``)
+attends to no keys and writes nothing.
+
+Built in two parts: the kernel weights after load (``__init__``, before vLLM's
+memory profiling), the launchers (one per row count and layer kind), scratch
+and peer buffer on the first decode step (``bind``: they depend on the cache
+page and the block-table width).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.distributed import (
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
+    get_tp_group,
+    tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.runtime.peer_memory import (  # noqa: E501
+    SymmetricPeerBuffer,
+)
+
+from .spec import DecodeConfig
+from .variants import load_variant
+from .weights import KINDS, LayerKind, MoeLayer, build_moe_layer, moe_kinds
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+HIDDEN = 6144
+FAULT_WORD_BYTES = 64
+
+# launch-order weight arguments (see mono/op.py Glm5MonoKernel.forward)
+_WEIGHT_ARGS = (
+    "g_in", "g_q", "g_kv", "g_post", "w_qkv_a", "s_qkv_a", "w_q_b", "s_q_b",
+    "w_uk", "s_uk", "w_uv", "s_uv", "w_o", "s_o", "w_r", "bias",
+    "w_ug", "s_ug", "w_dn", "s_dn",
+)  # fmt: skip
+
+
+def _ptr(t: torch.Tensor) -> int:
+    return t.data_ptr()
+
+
+def _variant(kind: str):
+    nope, kvs, _ = KINDS[kind]
+    return load_variant(nope, kvs)
+
+
+def _tp_agreed(error: str | None, group, npes: int) -> list[str]:
+    errors: list = [None] * npes
+    dist.all_gather_object(errors, error, group=group)
+    return [f"rank {r}: {e}" for r, e in enumerate(errors) if e is not None]
+
+
+def _kv_scale_refusal(moe) -> str | None:
+    """The kernel stores and reads an fp8 latent cache unscaled: every fp8
+    layer's KV scale must be 1.0."""
+    scales = {
+        float(getattr(lw.attn.attn, "_k_scale_float", 1.0))
+        for lw in moe
+        if str(lw.attn.attn.kv_cache_dtype).startswith("fp8")
+    }
+    if scales <= {1.0}:
+        return None
+    return (
+        f"fp8 latent KV cache with KV scales {sorted(scales)}: the specialized "
+        "decode reads and writes it unscaled (scale 1.0)"
+    )
+
+
+class MonoRunner:
+    """The per-layer kernel arguments, scratch, peer buffer and launchers."""
+
+    def __init__(self, model, config: DecodeConfig, max_model_len: int) -> None:
+        self.npes = npes = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        self.model = model
+        self.config = config
+        self.widths = tuple(config.widths)
+        self.max_rows = max(self.widths)
+        self.max_model_len = max_model_len
+        self.rank = get_tensor_model_parallel_rank()
+        self.cpu_group = get_tp_group().cpu_group
+        layers = list(model.layers)
+        self.kinds = kinds = moe_kinds(layers)
+        self.heads = layers[1].self_attn.num_local_heads
+        self.layer_name = layers[1].self_attn.attn.layer_name
+        self.index_name = layers[1].self_attn.indexer.k_cache.prefix
+        cs = model.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache
+        if cs.shape[0] < max_model_len or cs.shape[1] != 64:
+            raise ValueError(f"RoPE table {tuple(cs.shape)} for {max_model_len}")
+        cs = cs.float()
+        self.cos = cs[:, :32].contiguous()
+        self.sin = cs[:, 32:].contiguous()
+        error = None
+        try:
+            self.moe: list[MoeLayer] = [
+                build_moe_layer(layers[i], _variant(kind), self.rank, npes)
+                for i, kind in zip(range(1, len(layers)), kinds)
+            ]
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        except Exception as why:  # e.g. OOM on one rank: every rank raises
+            logger.exception("Mistral Large 4 specialized decode: weight build failed")
+            error = f"{type(why).__name__}: {why}"
+        failed = _tp_agreed(error, self.cpu_group, npes)
+        if failed:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode weight build failed: "
+                + "; ".join(failed)
+            )
+        # the KV scales are final once the weights are loaded: refuse at startup,
+        # not on the first decode step
+        failed = _tp_agreed(_kv_scale_refusal(self.moe), self.cpu_group, npes)
+        if failed:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode unsupported: " + "; ".join(failed)
+            )
+        repacked = sum(
+            t.numel() * t.element_size()
+            for lw in self.moe
+            for name, t in lw.args.items()
+            if not name.startswith(("w_ug", "s_ug", "w_dn", "s_dn"))
+            or name.endswith("_sh")
+        )
+        logger.info(
+            "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode: %d layer launches (%s), rows %s, "
+            "%.2f GiB of repacked weights per rank",
+            len(self.moe),
+            ", ".join(f"{k} x{kinds.count(k)}" for k in sorted(set(kinds))),
+            self.widths,
+            repacked / 2**30,
+        )
+        self.block_table_stride: int | None = None
+        self.peers: SymmetricPeerBuffer | None = None
+        dev = layers[0].input_layernorm.weight.device
+        # the fail-stop word reads 0 until the peer buffer exists
+        self.fault_word = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+
+    def _kv_cache_dtype(self) -> str:
+        """The kernel's latent cache dtype, from the bound caches: ``bf16`` or
+        ``fp8`` (E4M3, ATOM layout)."""
+        # vLLM allocates an fp8 cache as uint8 and views it as fp8 per call
+        fp8 = {torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.uint8}
+        dtypes = {lw.attn.attn.kv_cache.dtype for lw in self.moe}
+        if dtypes == {torch.bfloat16}:
+            return "bf16"
+        if len(dtypes) != 1 or not dtypes <= fp8:
+            raise ValueError(f"unsupported latent KV cache dtypes {dtypes}")
+        return "fp8"
+
+    @property
+    def bound(self) -> bool:
+        return self.block_table_stride is not None
+
+    def bind(self, page: int, block_table_stride: int) -> None:
+        """Launchers, scratch and peer buffer for the bound caches (collective:
+        every TP rank calls it on the same step, outside graph capture)."""
+        assert not self.bound
+        npes, heads, cfg = self.npes, self.heads, self.config
+        kv_cache_dtype = self._kv_cache_dtype()
+        unit = math.lcm(64, page)
+        index_max_seq = block_table_stride * page // unit * unit
+        if index_max_seq < self.max_model_len:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"block table covers {index_max_seq} < max_model_len "
+                f"{self.max_model_len}"
+            )
+        build_kwargs = dict(
+            heads=heads, npes=npes, topk=cfg.topk,
+            launches_per_step=len(self.moe), index_max_seq=index_max_seq,
+            index_request_width=cfg.q, index_page_size=page,
+            index_block_table_stride=block_table_stride, index_cache_dtype="fp8",
+            expert_mxfp4=True, atom_experts=True, attention_weight="fp8_block128",
+            kv_cache_layout="atom", kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype, native_fp4_mfma=True,
+            rope_dtype="fp32", uv_scale_rows=128, separate_shared=True,
+        )  # fmt: skip
+        scratch_bytes: dict[tuple[bool, bool], int] = {}
+        sym_bytes = 0
+        self.indices_offset: dict[int, int] = {}
+        builds = []
+        for rows in self.widths:
+            sym: dict[str, int] = {}
+            for kind in sorted(set(self.kinds)):
+                nope, kvs, with_indexer = KINDS[kind]
+                v = _variant(kind)
+                inter = v.geometry_config.glm5_tp_config(npes).inter
+                scr, sym_l = v.layout.layout(
+                    rows, heads, npes, cfg.topk, with_indexer, index_max_seq,
+                    inter=inter, native_fp4_mfma=True,
+                )  # fmt: skip
+                builds.append((rows, kind, v, inter, with_indexer))
+                key = (nope, kvs)
+                scratch_bytes[key] = max(scratch_bytes.get(key, 0), scr["_bytes"])
+                if kind == LayerKind.ROPE:
+                    self.indices_offset[rows] = scr["indices"]
+                for name, off in sym_l.items():
+                    if name != "_bytes" and sym.setdefault(name, off) != off:
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            f"peer layouts disagree on {name} at {rows} rows"
+                        )
+                sym_bytes = max(sym_bytes, sym_l["_bytes"])
+        fault_offset = -(-sym_bytes // FAULT_WORD_BYTES) * FAULT_WORD_BYTES
+        self.launch = {
+            (rows, kind): v.op.build_glm5_monokernel(
+                **build_kwargs,
+                S=rows,
+                inter=inter,
+                output_heads=heads,
+                with_indexer=with_indexer,
+                shared_indices=kind == LayerKind.ROPE_SHARED,
+                fault_offset=fault_offset,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+            for rows, kind, v, inter, with_indexer in builds
+        }
+        dev = self.cos.device
+        # one rank-local scratch per kernel package (sized for the widest
+        # step): mailboxes of different geometries never share bytes; the RoPE
+        # package's holds the top-k the index-sharing layers read
+        self.scratch = {
+            key: torch.zeros(n, dtype=torch.uint8, device=dev)
+            for key, n in scratch_bytes.items()
+        }
+        self.peers = SymmetricPeerBuffer(
+            fault_offset + FAULT_WORD_BYTES,
+            rank=self.rank,
+            npes=npes,
+            group=self.cpu_group,
+        )
+        self.fault_word = self.peers.storage[fault_offset : fault_offset + 4].view(
+            torch.int32
+        )
+        self.step = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+        self.x = [
+            torch.empty(self.max_rows, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        self.indptr = torch.zeros(self.max_rows + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+        self.block_table_stride = block_table_stride
+        logger.info(
+            "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode bound: page %d, index capacity %d, "
+            "%d launchers",
+            page,
+            index_max_seq,
+            len(self.launch),
+        )
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        if self.peers is not None:
+            self.peers.close()
+            self.peers = None
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor]]:
+        assert self.peers is not None
+        rows = positions.shape[0]
+        assert rows in self.widths
+        model = self.model
+        hidden = (
+            inputs_embeds
+            if inputs_embeds is not None
+            else model.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        )
+        log_positions = torch.log(positions.to(torch.float32) + 1)
+        layer0 = model.layers[0]
+        hidden, residual = layer0.input_norm(hidden, None)
+        # aux hidden-state taps (DSpark): the residual stream entering layer idx,
+        # as _stock_forward takes it after that layer's input norm
+        taps = model.aux_hidden_state_layers
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        if 0 in taps:
+            aux_hidden_states.append(residual.clone())
+        hidden, residual = layer0(
+            positions, hidden, residual, log_positions, model.rotary_emb
+        )
+        if layer0.defer_allreduce:
+            # the dense MLP left a TP-partial sum (its reduction is fused into
+            # the next layer's input norm, which the kernels replace)
+            hidden = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(hidden)
+        torch.add(hidden, residual, out=self.x[0][:rows])
+        fwd = get_forward_context()
+        block_table = fwd.attn_metadata[self.layer_name].block_table
+        slots = fwd.slot_mapping[self.layer_name]
+        # keys per row (cumulative): the whole context up to top-k, none for a
+        # padded row
+        nkeys = torch.where(
+            slots[:rows] >= 0,
+            torch.clamp(positions[:rows] + 1, max=self.config.topk),
+            0,
+        ).to(torch.int32)
+        self.indptr[1 : rows + 1].copy_(torch.cumsum(nkeys, 0))
+        rope_scratch = self.scratch[(False, False)]
+        stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()
+        for i, lw in enumerate(self.moe):
+            a = lw.args
+            kv = lw.attn.attn.kv_cache
+            if lw.kind == LayerKind.ROPE_SHARED:
+                index_arg = _ptr(rope_scratch) + self.indices_offset[rows]
+            else:
+                index_arg = _ptr(lw.attn.indexer.k_cache.kv_cache)
+            nope, kvs, _ = KINDS[lw.kind]
+            if i + 1 in taps:
+                # launch i is layer i + 1 and reads x[i % 2]; launch i + 1
+                # overwrites it
+                aux_hidden_states.append(self.x[i % 2][:rows].clone())
+            self.launch[(rows, lw.kind)](
+                _ptr(self.x[i % 2]), _ptr(self.x[(i + 1) % 2]), _ptr(block_table),
+                _ptr(positions), _ptr(slots), _ptr(self.indptr),
+                _ptr(kv), _ptr(kv), index_arg, _ptr(self.cos), _ptr(self.sin),
+                *(_ptr(a[name]) for name in _WEIGHT_ARGS),
+                _ptr(self.scratch[(nope, kvs)]), self.peers.local_address,
+                _ptr(self.peers.addresses), _ptr(lw.params), _ptr(self.step),
+                self.rank, i,
+                stream=stream,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+        self.step.add_(1)
+        x = self.x[len(self.moe) % 2][:rows]
+        if len(model.layers) in taps:
+            aux_hidden_states.append(x.clone())
+        hidden = model.norm(x)
+        if aux_hidden_states:
+            return hidden, aux_hidden_states
+        return hidden

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Side-effect-free Mistral Large 4 specialized-decode configuration."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass, replace
+
+from vllm.config import CompilationMode, VllmConfig
+
+AUTO, SPECIALIZED = "auto", "latency_specialized"
+# the kernel's step rows at most (``mono/kernel.py``: ``1 <= S <= 12``)
+MAX_ROWS = 12
+# speculative methods whose verify step the kernels serve: a uniform block of
+# ``num_speculative_tokens + 1`` causal rows per request, the target's residual
+# stream tapped at ``aux_hidden_state_layers``
+SPEC_METHODS = ("dspark",)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class DecodeConfig:
+    tp_size: int = 4  # the fused indexer's q_b split needs 16 local heads
+    blocks: int = 256  # one CTA per CU, all co-resident
+    # rows a launch serves (one decode token per request): vLLM's FULL-graph
+    # capture sizes, so graph replays pad decode batches to them; eager steps
+    # of other sizes and batches above 4 rows run stock. The 8-row launch
+    # builds and is correct but measured slower than vLLM's layers (super-linear
+    # up/gate and down stages), so it is not served.
+    widths: tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 4)
+    topk: int = 2048
+    # rows a request takes in a step: 1, or num_speculative_tokens + 1 for a
+    # speculative verify block (the kernels' ``index_request_width``)
+    q: int = 1
+
+    def refusal_reasons(self, config: VllmConfig) -> list[str]:
+        """Default-deny: every deployment feature the kernels do not serve."""
+        pc = config.parallel_config
+        cc = config.cache_config
+        reasons: list[str] = []
+        if pc.tensor_parallel_size != self.tp_size:
+            reasons.append(f"requires tensor parallel size {self.tp_size}")
+        if pc.pipeline_parallel_size != 1:
+            reasons.append("does not support pipeline parallelism")
+        if pc.data_parallel_size != 1:
+            reasons.append("does not support data parallelism")
+        if pc.decode_context_parallel_size != 1:
+            reasons.append("does not support decode context parallelism")
+        if pc.prefill_context_parallel_size != 1:
+            reasons.append("does not support prefill context parallelism")
+        if pc.use_ubatching:
+            reasons.append("does not support DBO or ubatching")
+        if pc.enable_expert_parallel:
+            reasons.append("does not support expert parallelism")
+        if pc.enable_eplb:
+            reasons.append("does not support EPLB")
+        if str(cc.cache_dtype) not in ("auto", "bfloat16", "fp8", "fp8_e4m3"):
+            reasons.append("requires a bf16 or fp8 (e4m3) KV cache")
+        if cc.block_size is not None and cc.block_size % 16:
+            reasons.append("requires a KV cache block size that is a multiple of 16")
+        if cc.kv_offloading_size is not None:
+            reasons.append("does not support KV cache offloading")
+        if config.lora_config is not None:
+            reasons.append("does not support LoRA")
+        transfer = config.kv_transfer_config
+        if transfer is not None and transfer.kv_connector is not None:
+            reasons.append("does not support a KV connector")
+        if not config.use_v2_model_runner:
+            reasons.append("requires Model Runner V2")
+        spec = config.speculative_config
+        if spec is not None:
+            if getattr(spec, "method", None) not in SPEC_METHODS:
+                reasons.append(
+                    "supports only " + "/".join(SPEC_METHODS) + " speculative decoding"
+                )
+            dynamic = getattr(spec, "uses_dynamic_speculative_decoding", None)
+            if dynamic is not None and dynamic():
+                reasons.append("does not support dynamic speculative decoding")
+            if (getattr(spec, "num_speculative_tokens", 0) or 0) + 1 > MAX_ROWS:
+                reasons.append(f"supports at most {MAX_ROWS - 1} speculative tokens")
+        if config.model_config.enable_sleep_mode:
+            reasons.append("does not support sleep mode")
+        if config.weight_transfer_config is not None:
+            reasons.append("does not support weight transfer or updates")
+        offload = config.offload_config
+        if offload.uva.cpu_offload_gb > 0 or offload.prefetch.offload_group_size > 0:
+            reasons.append("does not support model weight offloading")
+        if config.compilation_config.mode == CompilationMode.STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE:
+            reasons.append("does not support stock torch.compile")
+        aux = config.aux_output_config
+        if getattr(aux, "enable_return_routed_experts", False):
+            reasons.append("does not support routed-expert capture")
+        quant = config.model_config.quantization
+        if quant == "fp8" and (
+            os.environ.get("VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT", "").lower() != "mxfp4"
+            or os.environ.get("VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT_ACT", "a8w4").lower() != "a4w4"
+        ):
+            reasons.append(
+                "requires MXFP4 a4w4 routed experts (VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT=mxfp4 "
+                "VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT_ACT=a4w4)"
+            )
+        return reasons
+
+
+DECODE_CONFIG = DecodeConfig()
+
+
+def decode_backend(config: VllmConfig) -> str:
+    """The requested decode backend: ``--additional-config
+    '{"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}'``, or ``--monokernel`` where the
+    kernel config has it."""
+    if getattr(config.kernel_config, "monokernel", False):
+        return SPECIALIZED
+    extra = config.additional_config
+    return extra.get("decode_backend", AUTO) if isinstance(extra, dict) else AUTO
+
+
+def specialized_decode_config(config: VllmConfig) -> DecodeConfig | None:
+    """The deployment's specialized decode, None for vLLM's decode. Raises with
+    every reason when it is requested for an unsupported deployment."""
+    backend = decode_backend(config)
+    if backend == AUTO:
+        return None
+    if backend != SPECIALIZED:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"decode_backend must be '{AUTO}' or '{SPECIALIZED}', got {backend!r}"
+        )
+    reasons = DECODE_CONFIG.refusal_reasons(config)
+    if reasons:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Mistral Large 4 specialized decode unsupported: " + "; ".join(reasons)
+        )
+    spec = config.speculative_config
+    if spec is None:
+        return DECODE_CONFIG
+    # one request's verify block (q rows) per launch: two requests (8 rows at
+    # q=4) build and are correct but measured slower than vLLM's layers, as the
+    # 8-row launch without speculation (see ``widths``)
+    q = spec.num_speculative_tokens + 1
+    return replace(DECODE_CONFIG, q=q, widths=(q,))

+"""Per-layer-type instances of the ``kernels`` package.
+
+The layer geometry (NoPE query width, KV sharing) is a module-level constant of
+the kernel sources (``kernels/variant.py``), so each layer type loads the one
+source tree under its own package name with its own ``variant`` module.
+"""
+
+import importlib
+import importlib.util
+import sys
+import types
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import NamedTuple
+
+_KERNELS = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "mono"
+
+
+class KernelVariant(NamedTuple):
+    op: types.ModuleType
+    layout: types.ModuleType
+    geometry_config: types.ModuleType
+
+
+def load_variant(nope: bool, kv_share: bool) -> KernelVariant:
+    """The kernel package compiled for one ML4 layer type."""
+    assert nope or not kv_share, "KV-sharing layers are NoPE layers"
+    name = f"{__package__}._kernels_{'nope' if nope else 'rope'}{'_kvs' if kv_share else ''}"  # noqa: E501
+    if name not in sys.modules:
+        variant = types.ModuleType(f"{name}.variant")
+        variant.NOPE_LAYER = nope  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        variant.KV_SHARE = kv_share  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        sys.modules[variant.__name__] = variant
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+            name, _KERNELS / "__init__.py", submodule_search_locations=[str(_KERNELS)]
+        )
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        package = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = package
+        spec.loader.exec_module(package)
+    return KernelVariant(
+        importlib.import_module(f"{name}.op"),
+        importlib.import_module(f"{name}.layout"),
+        importlib.import_module(f"{name}.geometry_config"),
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""One MoE decoder layer's kernel arguments, built from the loaded vLLM modules.
+
+Attention / indexer / router weights are repacked into the kernels' tiled
+formats (copies). The routed experts are read in place: vLLM's AITER a4w4 MXFP4
+storage (aiter ``shuffle_weight`` values, ``e8m0_shuffle`` scales) is the
+kernels' ATOM layout. The shared expert, a separate block-FP8 MLP in vLLM, is
+re-quantized to MXFP4 the way ``VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT`` quantizes the routed
+experts and passed through its own pointers.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.online.fp8_requant import (
+    dequant_block_fp8_to_bf16,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp4_utils import mxfp4_quantize
+from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.runtime.consensus import (  # noqa: E501
+    MonoUnsupported,
+)
+from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.weights.config import (  # noqa: E501
+    Mxfp4ScaleLayout,
+    Mxfp4WeightLayout,
+)
+from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.weights.layer import (  # noqa: E501
+    LayerWeights,
+)
+from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.mono.common.weights.packing import (  # noqa: E501
+    pack_bf16,
+    pack_fp8,
+)
+from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.amd.specialized_decode.runtime.variants import (
+    KernelVariant,
+)
+
+FP8 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+N_ROUTED = 128
+INDEX_HEADS = 32
+INDEX_DIM = 128
+FP8_BLOCK = [128, 128]
+
+
+class LayerKind:
+    """Kernel variant of one MoE layer (``variants.load_variant`` + build flags)."""
+
+    ROPE = "rope"  # RoPE, own indexer
+    ROPE_SHARED = "rope_shared"  # RoPE, top-k of the preceding indexer layer
+    NOPE = "nope"  # NoPE, own indexer
+    NOPE_KVS = "nope_kvs"  # NoPE, own indexer, reads the source layer's latent cache
+
+
+def layer_kind(spec) -> str:
+    if spec.use_rope:
+        if spec.shares_kv:
+            raise MonoUnsupported(f"layer {spec.layer_idx}: RoPE layer sharing KV")
+        if spec.has_indexer and spec.indexer_use_rope:
+            return LayerKind.ROPE
+        if not spec.has_indexer and spec.use_sparse:
+            return LayerKind.ROPE_SHARED
+    elif spec.has_indexer and not spec.indexer_use_rope:
+        return LayerKind.NOPE_KVS if spec.shares_kv else LayerKind.NOPE
+    raise MonoUnsupported(f"layer {spec.layer_idx}: unsupported layer type {spec}")
+
+
+# kind -> (NoPE, KV-share, fused indexer)
+KINDS = {
+    LayerKind.ROPE: (False, False, True),
+    LayerKind.ROPE_SHARED: (False, False, False),
+    LayerKind.NOPE: (True, False, True),
+    LayerKind.NOPE_KVS: (True, True, True),
+}
+
+
+def moe_kinds(layers) -> list[str]:
+    """Kernel variant per MoE layer (1..); raises when the layer mix is unsupported."""
+    if layers[0].self_attn.spec.is_moe or not all(
+        lyr.self_attn.spec.is_moe for lyr in layers[1:]
+    ):
+        raise MonoUnsupported("layer mix: expected one dense layer, then MoE layers")
+    kinds = [layer_kind(lyr.self_attn.spec) for lyr in layers[1:]]
+    last_indexer = None
+    for i, kind in enumerate(kinds):
+        if kind == LayerKind.ROPE_SHARED and last_indexer != LayerKind.ROPE:
+            # the top-k is read from the RoPE package's scratch
+            raise MonoUnsupported(f"layer {i + 1}: shared top-k after {last_indexer}")
+        if KINDS[kind][2]:
+            last_indexer = kind
+    return kinds
+
+
+def check_moe_layer(layer, npes: int = 4) -> None:
+    """The weight checks of ``build_moe_layer`` without building anything."""
+    attn = layer.self_attn
+    if attn.num_local_heads * npes != 64 or attn.v_head_dim != 128:
+        raise MonoUnsupported("attention geometry")
+    _fp8_param(attn.q_proj)
+    _fp8_param(attn.o_proj)
+    w = attn.kv_b_proj.weight
+    if w.dtype != torch.bfloat16 or w.shape[-1] != 512:
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"kv_b_proj {w.dtype} {tuple(w.shape)}")
+    if attn.ssmax is None:
+        raise MonoUnsupported("attention without SSMax")
+    ix = attn.indexer
+    if ix is not None:
+        if ix.ssmax is None or ix.n_head != INDEX_HEADS or ix.head_dim != INDEX_DIM:
+            raise MonoUnsupported("indexer geometry")
+        _fp8_param(ix.wq_b)
+    if layer.mlp.shared_experts is None:
+        raise MonoUnsupported("MoE layer without a shared expert")
+    _fp8_param(layer.mlp.shared_experts.gate_up_proj)
+    _fp8_param(layer.mlp.shared_experts.down_proj)
+    _routed_experts(layer.mlp.experts)
+
+
+def _q128(w: torch.Tensor, block_cols: int = 128) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """bf16/fp32 [r, c] -> (fp8, fp32 scale per 128 x block_cols block), amax / 448."""
+    r, c = w.shape
+    w = w.float()
+    wp = F.pad(w, (0, (-c) % block_cols, 0, (-r) % 128))
+    b = wp.view(wp.shape[0] // 128, 128, wp.shape[1] // block_cols, block_cols)
+    s = b.abs().amax((1, 3)).clamp_min(1e-12) / 448.0
+    q = (b / s[:, None, :, None]).clamp(-448, 448).view_as(wp)[:r, :c].to(FP8)
+    return q.contiguous(), s.contiguous()
+
+
+def _fp8_param(linear) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """A block-FP8 linear's [N, K] fp8 weight and fp32 [N/128, K/128] scales."""
+    w = linear.weight
+    s = getattr(linear, "weight_scale_inv", None)
+    if s is None:
+        s = getattr(linear, "weight_scale", None)
+    if w.dtype != FP8 or s is None or s.dtype != torch.float32:
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"{type(linear).__name__}: expected block-FP8 weights")
+    n, k = w.shape[-2:]
+    if tuple(s.shape) != ((n + 127) // 128, (k + 127) // 128):
+        # transposed storage (a kernel that keeps W^T) is not read here
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"block scales {tuple(s.shape)} for weight {(n, k)}")
+    return w.contiguous(), s.contiguous()
+
+
+def _shared_expert_mxfp4(mlp) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """The shared expert re-quantized to MXFP4 in vLLM's a4w4 storage layout."""
+    from aiter.utility.fp4_utils import e8m0_shuffle
+
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+
+    def mx(linear):
+        w, s = _fp8_param(linear)
+        q, sc = mxfp4_quantize(dequant_block_fp8_to_bf16(w, s, FP8_BLOCK))
+        return q.view(torch.uint8), sc.view(torch.uint8)
+
+    ug, s_ug = mx(mlp.gate_up_proj)  # rows [gate; up], as w13
+    dn, s_dn = mx(mlp.down_proj)
+    fp4 = torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2
+    w13, w2 = rocm_aiter_ops.shuffle_weights(
+        ug[None].contiguous().view(fp4), dn[None].contiguous().view(fp4)
+    )
+    out = {
+        "w_ug_sh": w13.view(torch.uint8).contiguous(),
+        "w_dn_sh": w2.view(torch.uint8).contiguous(),
+        "s_ug_sh": e8m0_shuffle(s_ug.contiguous()).contiguous(),
+        "s_dn_sh": e8m0_shuffle(s_dn.contiguous()).contiguous(),
+    }
+    return out
+
+
+def _routed_experts(experts) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Views of vLLM's routed-expert storage (no copy)."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+
+    experts = getattr(experts, "routed_experts", experts)  # shared-expert wrapper
+    method = getattr(experts, "quant_method", None)
+    method = getattr(method, "old_quant_method", method)  # modular-kernel wrapper
+    backend = getattr(method, "mxfp4_backend", None)
+    if backend != Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_MXFP4:
+        raise MonoUnsupported(
+            f"routed experts on {backend} ({type(experts).__name__}/"
+            f"{type(method).__name__}); mono reads AITER a4w4 storage "
+            "(VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT=mxfp4 VLLM_FP8_MOE_REQUANT_ACT=a4w4)"
+        )
+    out = {}
+    for name, key in (
+        ("w13_weight", "w_ug"),
+        ("w13_weight_scale", "s_ug"),
+        ("w2_weight", "w_dn"),
+        ("w2_weight_scale", "s_dn"),
+    ):
+        t = getattr(experts, name).data
+        if t.shape[0] != N_ROUTED or not t.is_contiguous():
+            raise MonoUnsupported(f"{name} {tuple(t.shape)}")
+        v = t.view(torch.uint8)
+        if key.startswith("w"):
+            v.is_shuffled = True  # aiter shuffle_weight layout (backend checked above)
+        out[key] = v
+    return out
+
+
+@dataclass
+class MoeLayer:
+    """One MoE layer's kernel inputs (``args``: launch-order tensors by name)."""
+
+    layer_id: int
+    kind: str
+    args: dict[str, torch.Tensor]
+    params: torch.Tensor  # int64 pointer table (indexer weights, shared expert)
+    attn: Any  # MistralMLAAttention (cache bindings are read per step)
+
+
+def build_moe_layer(layer, variant: KernelVariant, rank: int, npes: int) -> MoeLayer:
+    attn = layer.self_attn
+    spec = attn.spec
+    kind = layer_kind(spec)
+    gc = variant.geometry_config
+    C = gc.glm5_tp_config(npes)
+    nh, nope, pe, kvl, vd = C.local_heads, C.nope_dim, C.pe_dim, C.kv_lora, C.v_dim
+    hidden = C.hidden
+    dev = layer.input_layernorm.weight.device
+    if (
+        attn.num_local_heads != nh
+        or attn.qk_nope_head_dim != nope
+        or attn.v_head_dim != vd
+    ):
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"layer {spec.layer_idx}: attention geometry")
+
+    t: dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    t["w_q_b"], t["s_q_b"] = _fp8_param(attn.q_proj)
+    if spec.shares_kv:
+        # the kernel reads this launch's latent row from the source cache
+        t["w_qkv_a"], t["s_qkv_a"] = _q128(torch.zeros(kvl + pe, hidden, device=dev))
+        t["g_kv"] = torch.ones(kvl, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=dev)
+    else:
+        wkva = attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa.weight.float()
+        if wkva.shape[0] == kvl:  # NoPE: zero rope-key rows -> cached rope key 0
+            wkva = torch.cat([wkva, torch.zeros(pe, hidden, device=dev)])
+        t["w_qkv_a"], t["s_qkv_a"] = _q128(wkva)
+        t["g_kv"] = attn.kv_a_layernorm.weight.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+    wkvb = attn.kv_b_proj.weight
+    if wkvb.dtype != torch.bfloat16 or wkvb.shape != (nh * (nope + vd), kvl):
+        raise MonoUnsupported(f"kv_b_proj {wkvb.dtype} {tuple(wkvb.shape)}")
+    wkvb = wkvb.float().view(nh, nope + vd, kvl)
+    w_uk = wkvb[:, :nope, :].transpose(1, 2).reshape(nh * kvl, nope)
+    w_uv = wkvb[:, nope:, :].reshape(nh * vd, kvl)
+    t["w_uk"], t["s_uk"] = _q128(w_uk, 64)  # the absorb GEMV reads 128 x 64 scales
+    t["w_uv"], t["s_uv"] = _q128(w_uv)
+    t["w_o"], t["s_o"] = _fp8_param(attn.o_proj)
+    t["g_in"] = layer.input_layernorm.weight.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+    t["g_post"] = layer.post_attention_layernorm.weight.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+    t["w_r"] = layer.mlp.gate.weight.to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+    t["bias"] = torch.zeros(N_ROUTED, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+
+    # fp32 parameter table read through the g_q pointer: indexer q LayerNorm,
+    # attention and indexer SSMax
+    prm = torch.zeros(gc.ML4_P_WORDS, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+    if attn.ssmax is None:
+        raise MonoUnsupported("attention without SSMax")
+    prm[gc.ML4_P_SS_S : gc.ML4_P_SS_S + nh] = attn.ssmax.s.float()
+    prm[gc.ML4_P_SS_B : gc.ML4_P_SS_B + nh] = attn.ssmax.b.float()
+    ix = attn.indexer
+    if ix is not None:
+        if ix.ssmax is None or ix.n_head != INDEX_HEADS or ix.head_dim != INDEX_DIM:
+            raise MonoUnsupported("indexer geometry")
+        prm[gc.ML4_P_IQ_W : gc.ML4_P_IQ_W + hidden] = ix.q_input_norm.weight.float()
+        prm[gc.ML4_P_IQ_B : gc.ML4_P_IQ_B + hidden] = ix.q_input_norm.bias.float()
+        prm[gc.ML4_P_ISS_S : gc.ML4_P_ISS_S + INDEX_HEADS] = ix.ssmax.s.float()
+        prm[gc.ML4_P_ISS_B : gc.ML4_P_ISS_B + INDEX_HEADS] = ix.ssmax.b.float()
+        t["w_index_q"], t["s_index_q"] = _fp8_param(ix.wq_b)
+        kw = ix.wk_weights_proj.weight
+        t["w_index_k"], t["s_index_k"] = _q128(kw[:INDEX_DIM])
+        t["w_index_w"] = kw[INDEX_DIM:].to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous()
+        t["g_index_k"] = ix.k_norm.weight.float().contiguous()
+        t["b_index_k"] = ix.k_norm.bias.float().contiguous()
+    t["g_q"] = prm
+
+    t.update(_routed_experts(layer.mlp.experts))
+    shared = layer.mlp.shared_experts
+    if shared is None:
+        raise MonoUnsupported("MoE layer without a shared expert")
+    t.update(_shared_expert_mxfp4(shared))
+
+    W = LayerWeights(
+        nh, t, C, rank, npes,
+        mxfp4_weight_layout=Mxfp4WeightLayout.ATOM,
+        mxfp4_scale_layout=Mxfp4ScaleLayout.ATOM,
+        physical_experts=N_ROUTED,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    packed = variant.op.prepare_glm5_weights(W, "fp8_block128")
+    if ix is not None:
+        packed["w_index_k"] = pack_fp8(t["w_index_k"])
+        packed["w_index_q"] = pack_fp8(t["w_index_q"])
+        packed["w_index_w"] = pack_bf16(t["w_index_w"])
+    args = dict(t, **packed)
+    params = torch.tensor(
+        variant.op.param_table(args, ix is not None, True),
+        dtype=torch.int64,
+        device=dev,
+    )
+    # drop the unpacked copies this build made (packed replacements exist)
+    for name in ("w_qkv_a", "w_uk", "w_uv", "w_index_k", "w_index_w"):
+        if name in packed and args[name] is not t.get(name):
+            t.pop(name, None)
+    return MoeLayer(spec.layer_idx, kind, args, params, attn)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Mistral Large 4 DSpark draft model (dense MLA backbone + Markov head).
+
+Draft layers are non-causal dense MLA blocks with the target's attention
+geometry. Each draft layer caches latent K/V projected from the normalized
+target taps (``combine_hidden_states``) and from its own query block. Draft
+weights are BF16 and the draft RoPE is the target's YaRN without LeRoPE.
+Checkpoint options select the trained variant:
+
+* ``dspark_head_type="rnn"``: the Markov bias comes from a gated recurrent
+  state carried across the draft positions of one proposal instead of from
+  the previous token alone.
+* ``dspark_draft_input="position_specific"``: ``mask_embedding`` has one row
+  per mask slot; slot ``k`` of a ``[anchor, mask_1, ...]`` block reads row
+  ``k - 1`` instead of sharing one vector.
+* ``layer_types``/``sliding_window``: windowed draft layers see the last
+  ``sliding_window`` context tokens before the anchor plus their whole block.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+
+import regex as re
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.weight_utils import default_weight_loader
+from vllm.model_executor.models.qwen3_dspark import DSparkMarkovHead
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import get_draft_quant_config, maybe_prefix
+from vllm.models.mistral.common.layer_spec import MistralLayerSpec
+from vllm.models.mistral.common.rope import MistralRotaryEmbedding
+from vllm.models.mistral.mistral_large4.nvidia.model import (
+    _STACKED_PARAMS,
+    MistralLarge4DecoderLayer,
+    _to_vllm_weight_name,
+)
+
+# Mistral DSpark checkpoint name (after the ``mtp_dspark.`` prefix) -> module.
+_DSPARK_NAME_MAP: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
+    (r"^backbone\.target_projection\.", "model.target_projection."),
+    (r"^backbone\.target_norm\.", "model.target_norm."),
+    (r"^backbone\.final_norm\.", "model.final_norm."),
+    (r"^backbone\.mask_embedding$", "model.mask_embedding"),
+    (r"^autoregressive_head\.embedding\.", "model.markov_head.markov_w1."),
+    (r"^autoregressive_head\.output\.", "model.markov_head.markov_w2."),
+    (r"^autoregressive_head\.joint_proj\.", "model.joint_proj."),
+]
+_DSPARK_PREFIX = "mtp_dspark."
+
+
+def _to_draft_weight_name(ckpt_name: str) -> str:
+    name = ckpt_name.removeprefix(_DSPARK_PREFIX)
+    if name.startswith("backbone.layers."):
+        return _to_vllm_weight_name(name.removeprefix("backbone."))
+    for pattern, repl in _DSPARK_NAME_MAP:
+        name = re.sub(pattern, repl, name)
+    return name

+def draft_attention_windows(config, num_speculative_tokens: int) -> list[int | None]:
+    """Per-layer decode window (keys counted back from the end of the block).
+
+    The draft block is part of the attended sequence, so the window is widened
+    by its length: the queries then see the ``sliding_window`` context tokens up
+    to the anchor's source position, as in training.
+    """
+    layer_types = getattr(config, "layer_types", None) or (
+        ["full_attention"] * config.num_hidden_layers
+    )
+    return [
+        config.sliding_window + num_speculative_tokens
+        if layer_type == "sliding_attention"
+        else None
+        for layer_type in layer_types
+    ]
+

+class MistralLarge4DSparkModel(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, start_layer_id: int, prefix: str = ""

+        hidden_size = config.hidden_size
+        self.vocab_size = config.vocab_size

+        self.embed_tokens: nn.Module | None = None

+        mask_shape: tuple[int, ...] = (hidden_size,)
+        if self.position_specific:

+                "Position-specific DSpark masks need num_speculative_tokens equal "
+                f"to the trained depth {self.block_size}, got {num_spec}"

+                    has_indexer=False,
+                    indexer_use_rope=False,

+                topk_indices_buffer=None,
+                index_group_builder=None,
+                # Only read by KV-sharing and NoPE layers, which drafts lack.
+                zero_kv_inputs=(torch.empty(0), torch.empty(0)),
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                non_causal=True,
+                sliding_window=windows[i],

+        )

+
+        markov_rank = config.markov_rank
+        self.markov_head = DSparkMarkovHead(
+            self.vocab_size,
+            self.vocab_size,
+            markov_rank,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "markov_head"),
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+        )

+        if config.dspark_head_type == "rnn":

+                hidden_size + 2 * markov_rank,

+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Embed draft blocks, replacing the out-of-vocabulary mask slots."""
+        assert self.embed_tokens is not None
+        if self.position_specific:
+            # Contiguous [anchor, mask_1, ..., mask_{D-1}] blocks per request.
+            assert input_ids.numel() % self.block_size == 0, (
+                f"Expected whole draft blocks of {self.block_size} tokens, got "
+                f"{input_ids.numel()}"
+            )
+            anchors = self.embed_tokens(
+                input_ids.view(-1, self.block_size)[:, 0].contiguous()
+            )
+            masks = self.mask_embedding.to(anchors.dtype).expand(
+                anchors.shape[0], -1, -1

+    def combine_hidden_states(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self.target_projection is not None:

+    @torch.inference_mode()
+    def precompute_and_store_context_kv(
+        self,
+        context_states: torch.Tensor,
+        context_positions: torch.Tensor,
+        context_slot_mapping: torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor | None] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Write each draft layer's latent K/V for the target context tokens.
+
+        The context is already normalized (``target_norm``), so it bypasses the
+        layers' input norms, as in training.
+        """
+        for i, layer in enumerate(self.layers):
+            attn = layer.self_attn
+            kv = attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa(context_states)[0]
+            kv_c_normed = attn.kv_a_layernorm(kv[:, : attn.kv_lora_rank])
+            k_pe = kv[:, None, attn.kv_lora_rank :]
+            _, k_pe = self.rotary_emb(context_positions, torch.empty_like(k_pe), k_pe)
+            slot_mapping = (
+                context_slot_mapping[i]
+                if isinstance(context_slot_mapping, (list, tuple))
+                else context_slot_mapping
+            )
+            if slot_mapping is None:
+                continue

+            mla.impl.do_kv_cache_update(
+                kv_c_normed,
+                k_pe,
+                mla.kv_cache,
+                slot_mapping,
+                mla.kv_cache_dtype,
+                mla._k_scale,
+            )

+    def markov_step(
+        self,
+        token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        draft_hidden: torch.Tensor,
+        state: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """One recurrent Markov step: (output embedding, next state)."""
+        assert self.joint_proj is not None
+        embeds = self.markov_head.embed(token_ids)
+        if state is None:
+            state = torch.zeros_like(embeds)
+        joint = self.joint_proj(torch.cat((state, embeds, draft_hidden), dim=-1))[0]
+        gate_raw, candidate_raw, output_raw = joint.chunk(3, dim=-1)
+        gate = torch.sigmoid(gate_raw)
+        next_state = gate * state + (1.0 - gate) * torch.tanh(candidate_raw)
+        return torch.tanh(output_raw), next_state
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:

+            inputs_embeds = self.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+        # Only consumed by SSMax, which draft layers do not use.
+        log_positions = positions
+        hidden_states = inputs_embeds
+        residual = None
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            hidden_states, residual = layer.input_norm(hidden_states, residual)
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(
+                positions, hidden_states, residual, log_positions, self.rotary_emb
+            )
+        hidden_states, _ = self.layers[-1].residual_norm(
+            self.final_norm, hidden_states, residual
+        )
+        return hidden_states

+                if name.startswith(("model.markov_head.", "model.joint_proj."))
+            }

+def defers_allreduce(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> bool:
+    """Whether sublayers leave their outputs TP-partial and fuse the all-reduce
+    into the next residual RMSNorm."""
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    return bool(
+        vllm_config.compilation_config.pass_config.fuse_allreduce_rms
+        and vllm_config.model_config.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and not parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel
+        and not parallel_config.use_sequence_parallel_moe
+    )

+class MistralLarge4DecoderLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        config: PreTrainedConfig,
+        spec: MistralLayerSpec,
+        prefix: str,
+        topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None,
+        index_group_builder: SparseMLAIndexGroupBuilder | None,
+        zero_kv_inputs: tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None,
+        non_causal: bool = False,
+        sliding_window: int | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.defer_allreduce = defers_allreduce(vllm_config)
+        self.input_layernorm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.self_attn = MistralMLAAttention(
+            vllm_config,
+            config,
+            spec,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+            topk_indices_buffer=topk_indices_buffer,
+            index_group_builder=index_group_builder,
+            zero_kv_inputs=zero_kv_inputs,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            non_causal=non_causal,
+            sliding_window=sliding_window,
+            reduce_results=not self.defer_allreduce,
+        )
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = RMSNorm(
+            config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps
+        )
+        self.mlp: nn.Module
+        if spec.is_moe:
+            self.mlp = MistralMoE(
+                vllm_config,
+                config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                reduce_results=not self.defer_allreduce,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.mlp = MistralMLP(
+                config.hidden_size,
+                config.intermediate_size,
+                quant_config,
+                reduce_results=not self.defer_allreduce,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+            )
+
+    def residual_norm(
+        self, norm: RMSNorm, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, residual: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Add a sublayer output to the residual stream and normalize; with
+        ``defer_allreduce`` the output is a TP-partial sum reduced here."""
+        if self.defer_allreduce:
+            return fused_allreduce_rms_norm(hidden_states, residual, norm)
+        return norm(hidden_states, residual)
+
+    def input_norm(
+        self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, residual: torch.Tensor | None
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Fold the previous layer's output into the residual stream and
+        normalize; the returned residual is the stream entering this layer."""
+        if residual is None:
+            return self.input_layernorm(hidden_states), hidden_states
+        return self.residual_norm(self.input_layernorm, hidden_states, residual)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        log_positions: torch.Tensor,
+        rotary_emb: MistralRotaryEmbedding,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """Run the layer on the outputs of ``input_norm``."""
+        hidden_states = self.self_attn(
+            positions, hidden_states, log_positions, rotary_emb
+        )
+        hidden_states, residual = self.residual_norm(
+            self.post_attention_layernorm, hidden_states, residual
+        )
+        return self.mlp(hidden_states), residual

+            hidden_states, residual = layer.input_norm(hidden_states, residual)
+            if idx in self.aux_hidden_state_layers:
+                # Later residual norms may update the stream in place.
+                aux_hidden_states.append(residual.clone())
+            hidden_states, residual = layer(
+                positions, hidden_states, residual, log_positions, self.rotary_emb
+            )
+        if not get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            # Send the residual stream with the last output folded in: the next
+            # stage then starts like the first one (residual=None), so its first
+            # input_norm does not all-reduce again. PP sends only this rank's TP
+            # slice and all-gathers it, so the stream must be TP-replicated.
+            assert residual is not None
+            if self.defer_allreduce:
+                hidden_states = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(hidden_states)
+            return IntermediateTensors(
+                {
+                    "hidden_states": hidden_states + residual,
+                    **self.pack_local_aux_hidden_states(
+                        aux_hidden_states[num_remote_aux:]
+                    ),
+                }
+            )
+        hidden_states, residual = self.layers[self.end_layer - 1].residual_norm(
+            self.norm, hidden_states, residual
+        )
+        if self.end_layer in self.aux_hidden_state_layers:
+            aux_hidden_states.append(residual.clone())
+        if aux_hidden_states:
+            return hidden_states, aux_hidden_states
+        return hidden_states
+
+
+def _check_pp_stage(specs: list[MistralLayerSpec], start: int, end: int) -> None:
+    """A pipeline stage must own the KV cache and the top-k indices its layers
+    read: KV-sharing sources and the indexer a shared layer reuses stay local."""
+    for spec in specs[start:end]:
+        assert start <= spec.kv_source_layer < end, (
+            f"Layer {spec.layer_idx} shares the KV cache of layer "
+            f"{spec.kv_source_layer}, outside its pipeline stage [{start}, {end}); "
+            "set VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION so they share a stage"
+        )
+    first = specs[start] if start < end else None
+    assert first is None or not first.use_sparse or first.has_indexer, (
+        f"Pipeline stage [{start}, {end}) starts at layer {start}, which reuses "
+        "the top-k indices of a previous layer; set VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION so "
+        "every stage starts with an indexer layer"
+    )
+
+
+# Mistral consolidated checkpoint name -> vLLM name. Patterns match whole name
+# segments, so the map renames both weights and the module names quantization
+# configs list (e.g. `layers.1.attention.wq`).
+_CHECKPOINT_NAME_MAP: list[tuple[str, str]] = [
+    (r"^tok_embeddings(?=\.|$)", "model.embed_tokens"),
+    (r"^norm(?=\.|$)", "model.norm"),
+    (r"^output(?=\.|$)", "lm_head"),
+    (r"^layers\.", "model.layers."),
+    (r"\.attention_norm(?=\.|$)", ".input_layernorm"),
+    (r"\.ffn_norm(?=\.|$)", ".post_attention_layernorm"),
+    (r"\.attention\.indexer\.ssmax_scaling(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.indexer.ssmax"),
+    (r"\.attention\.ssmax_scaling(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.ssmax"),
+    (r"\.attention\.wq(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.q_proj"),
+    (r"\.attention\.wkv_a_with_mqa(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.kv_a_proj_with_mqa"),
+    (r"\.attention\.kv_a_norm(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.kv_a_layernorm"),
+    (r"\.attention\.wkv_b(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.kv_b_proj"),
+    (r"\.attention\.wo(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.o_proj"),
+    (r"\.attention\.indexer(?=\.|$)", ".self_attn.indexer"),
+    (r"\.feed_forward(?=\.|$)", ".mlp"),
+    (r"\.shared_experts(?=\.|$)", ".mlp.shared_experts"),
+    (r"\.gate(?=\.|$)", ".mlp.gate"),
+    (r"\.experts(?=\.|$)", ".mlp.experts"),
+    (r"\.qscale_weight$", ".weight_scale_inv"),
+]
+
+# (fused param, checkpoint shard, shard id)
+_STACKED_PARAMS: list[tuple[str, str, int]] = [
+    (".gate_up_proj.", ".w1.", 0),
+    (".gate_up_proj.", ".w3.", 1),
+    (".down_proj.", ".w2.", -1),
+    (".wk_weights_proj.", ".wk.", 0),
+    (".wk_weights_proj.", ".weights_proj.", 1),
+]
+
+
+def _to_vllm_weight_name(name: str) -> str:
+    for pattern, repl in _CHECKPOINT_NAME_MAP:
+        name = re.sub(pattern, repl, name)
+    return name
+
+
+def _map_quant_config_layers(quant_config: QuantizationConfig, prefix: str) -> None:
+    """Point the layer names of a Mistral-format quantization config at this
+    model's modules.
+
+    Such a config lists checkpoint modules (e.g. ModelOpt `quantized_layers`
+    keys such as `layers.1.attention.wq` or `layers.1.experts`); a fused module
+    resolves through the checkpoint modules stacked into it.
+    """
+    quant_config.apply_vllm_mapper(
+        WeightsMapper(
+            orig_to_new_regex={
+                re.compile(pattern): repl for pattern, repl in _CHECKPOINT_NAME_MAP
+            },
+            orig_to_new_prefix={
+                "model.": f"{maybe_prefix(prefix, 'model')}.",
+                "lm_head": maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+            },
+        )
+    )
+    stacked: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for param_part, ckpt_part, _ in _STACKED_PARAMS:
+        stacked.setdefault(param_part.strip("."), []).append(ckpt_part.strip("."))
+    quant_config.packed_modules_mapping = {
+        **quant_config.packed_modules_mapping,
+        **stacked,
+    }
+
+
+def _load_weights(
+    model: nn.Module,
+    mistral_model: MistralLarge4Model,
+    weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]],
+) -> set[str]:
+    """Load a Mistral consolidated checkpoint into ``model``.
+
+    ``model`` holds ``mistral_model`` as ``model.model`` and the LM head as
+    ``model.lm_head``.
+    """
+    config = mistral_model.config
+    params = dict(model.named_parameters())
+    expert_mapping = fused_moe_make_expert_params_mapping(
+        model,
+        ckpt_gate_proj_name="w1",
+        ckpt_down_proj_name="w2",
+        ckpt_up_proj_name="w3",
+        num_experts=getattr(config, "n_routed_experts", None) or 0,
+    )
+    loaded: set[str] = set()
+    lerope_alpha: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    for ckpt_name, weight in weights:
+        if ckpt_name == "lerope.alpha":
+            lerope_alpha = weight
+            continue
+        if ckpt_name.startswith("mtp_"):
+            # Speculative-decoding heads are loaded by their draft model.
+            continue
+        # Layers beyond the configured depth (e.g. a truncated debug model).
+        layer = re.match(r"layers\.(\d+)\.", ckpt_name)
+        if layer is not None and int(layer.group(1)) >= config.num_hidden_layers:
+            continue
+        name = _to_vllm_weight_name(ckpt_name)
+        if is_pp_missing_parameter(name, model):
+            continue
+
+        if ".mlp.experts." in name:
+            is_expert_weight = False
+            for param_name, weight_name, expert_id, shard_id in expert_mapping:
+                if weight_name not in name:
+                    continue
+                is_expert_weight = True
+                mapped = name.replace(weight_name, param_name)
+                param = params[mapped]
+                loader = cast(Callable[..., bool], param.weight_loader)
+                if loader(
+                    param,
+                    weight,
+                    mapped,
+                    shard_id=shard_id,
+                    expert_id=expert_id,
+                    return_success=True,
+                ):
+                    loaded.add(mapped)
+                    break
+            else:
+                # A known expert weight that is not local to this EP rank is skipped.
+                if not is_expert_weight:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Unexpected expert weight: {ckpt_name}")
+            continue
+
+        for param_part, ckpt_part, stacked_shard_id in _STACKED_PARAMS:
+            if ckpt_part not in name:
+                continue
+            name = name.replace(ckpt_part, param_part)
+            param = params[name]
+            if stacked_shard_id < 0:
+                param.weight_loader(param, weight)
+            else:
+                param.weight_loader(param, weight, stacked_shard_id)
+            break
+        else:
+            param = params[name]
+            getattr(param, "weight_loader", default_weight_loader)(param, weight)
+        loaded.add(name)
+
+    # The default loader skips this check for quantized models.
+    if missing := sorted(set(params) - loaded):
+        raise ValueError(f"Parameters not loaded from the checkpoint: {missing}")
+
+    if getattr(config, "lerope", False):
+        assert lerope_alpha is not None, "Checkpoint is missing lerope.alpha"
+        mistral_model.rotary_emb.set_lerope_alpha(lerope_alpha)
+    return loaded
+
+
+class MistralLarge4ForCausalLM(nn.Module, SupportsEagle3):
+    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = "") -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
+        self.config = config
+        if vllm_config.quant_config is not None:
+            _map_quant_config_layers(vllm_config.quant_config, prefix)
+        self.model = MistralLarge4Model(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
+        )
+        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
+            self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
+                config.vocab_size,
+                config.hidden_size,
+                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
+            )
+        else:
+            self.lm_head = PPMissingLayer()
+        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(
+            config.vocab_size, soft_cap=getattr(config, "softmax_tanh_gating", None)
+        )
+        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = (
+            self.model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors
+        )
+
+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.model.embed_input_ids(input_ids)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None = None,
+        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor]] | IntermediateTensors:
+        return self.model(input_ids, positions, intermediate_tensors, inputs_embeds)
+
+    def compute_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        return self.logits_processor(self.lm_head, hidden_states)
+
+    def load_weights(self, weights: Iterable[tuple[str, torch.Tensor]]) -> set[str]:
+        return _load_weights(self, self.model, weights)
